The gallery of twenty

Twenty new spells for the VFX tool, each with its own action and its own art style, made to the Scarlet Sheath's standard. Every sheet is the tool page playing the spell on its training targets, read left to right, top to bottom. They are on the tool page only, never in the game.

  • All twenty pass the engine's frame-by-frame self-test (no errors, they hit), also with the targets shuffled; type check and build pass.
  • The red floor under some spells before they land is the tool's danger zone, not the spell's colour.
1Kintsugi shatter
sure hit, delayedraku pottery and gold

A gold thread runs to the enemy, who is glazed black with creeping gold cracks; it bursts into shards that are pulled back and mended in gold.

2Carnival masquerade
blink behind and strikeVenetian carnival

A carousel of porcelain masks; the caster vanishes into them, steps out behind the enemy and cuts with teal silk; the masks tumble down.

3Quetzal descent
leap and slamAztec jade and gold

A jade feathered serpent carries the leap and slams down; stepped-fret tiles snap into a ring round the landing.

4Runestone fall
meteorNorse runestone

A carved granite stone falls from the sky, runes kindling one by one; one frost-blue flash, it lands upright and its runes fly into the floor ring.

5Mosaic nova
ring growing from the casterByzantine mosaic

Gold and lapis tesserae lift off the floor, hang, then race outward as a widening ring and crash down like a crown.

6Mandala unbinding
big timed zoneTibetan sand mandala

A sand mandala laid ring by ring, a dead beat, one flash, then swept away in a spiral of coloured grains.

7Celtic knot snare
trap that rootsCeltic interlace

A bronze knot drawn in one stroke, armed with moss-green pulses; its band lifts and coils round whoever stands on it.

8Watercolour vortex
pull to the centrewatercolour

Wet indigo and magenta swirl into a whirlpool that drags enemies in, then bloom outward with a cauliflower edge and dry to rings.

9Geode heart
bolt that grows crystalsamethyst geode

A grey stone tumbles out, cracks where it stops, and violet crystals spear outward from the hollow.

10Whalebone harpoon
hook that pullsArctic scrimshaw

A carved ivory harpoon flies on a paying-out rope, bites, reels the enemy in, and ink waves are etched into the ice.

11Molten glass bloom
coneglassblowing

A gob of hot glass is blown up on the pipe, then bursts into a fan of petals that cool to clear blue-green and shatter.

12Charcoal tempest
sweeping beamcharcoal sketch

A fan is sketched in pencil, then a ragged charcoal beam sweeps across it, smudging the floor and blotting whoever it passes.

13Art deco arc
chain between enemiesArt Deco

A gold zigzag bolt hops to four enemies, a sunburst fan opening at each; the chain stays a moment as a gilded diagram.

14Solar orrery
orbit, then homing strikesbrass orrery

A brass orrery opens round the caster, its rings spin up and stop dead, and its enamel planets fly off one by one at the enemies.

15Coral bastion
wall growing along a linecoral reef

A reef grows along the line branch by branch while fish scatter, then bleaches to bone and crumbles to sand.

16Gargoyle swoop
creature down a laneGothic cathedral

A stone gargoyle tears free from a corbel, glides low down a lane of gold tracery and shatters at its end.

17Arabesque fan
fan of five boltsPersian girih tiles

Loose tiles snap into five eight-pointed stars that fan out, each shattering into glazed tiles and a gold stamp where it stops.

18Crescent return
boomerang, out and backmoon silver

A silver crescent spun flat out along the lane and back, hitting both ways, caught again in a ring of star dust.

19Whiplash fissure
crack travelling along the groundArt Nouveau

A gold whip-vine races along the floor and the ground opens behind it in gilded, curling sage lips.

20Venom orchid
mark, then detonatebotanical

An orchid unfurls petal by petal at the enemy's feet, pulses twice, then bursts into a lingering pollen cloud.
